title: Uniform convergence with a common compact support gives convergence of integrals against a measure finite on compacts
statement:
Let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N that is finite on compact sets, and let K ⊆ ℝ^N be compact. Let G and F_k (k ∈ ℕ) be μ-integrable functions ℝ^N → ℝ such that:
- F_k(y) = G(y) for every k and every y ∉ K;
- for every ε > 0 there is k₀ ∈ ℕ with |F_k(y) − G(y)| ≤ ε for all k ≥ k₀ and all y ∈ ℝ^N.
Then ∫ F_k dμ → ∫ G dμ as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (F : ℕ → Euclidean N → ℝ) (G : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → IsCompact K → (∀ k, Integrable (F k) μ) → Integrable G μ → (∀ k, ∀ y ∉ K, F k y = G y) → (∀ ε > 0, ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ y, |F k y - G y| ≤ ε) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y, F k y ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, G y ∂μ))
